GRAVLAX! Not going to lie, fam…I posted a short form video of this last night, and almost 5 million people saw it in 24 hours. First off, my mind is blown. Thank y’all for checking it out. Second off, I wanted to post a full length play-by-play for those of you who may want to try it at home but don’t get enough detail! It’s so easy, relatively inexpensive, and the ROI is off the charts.  That said, start with high quality salmon from a trusted source. I always recommend either previously deep frozen wild, OR sustainably farm raised fish for this (this basically nullifies the risk of parasites). If going farm raised, be picky and get the good stuff (Ora King or Faroe Islands are the only ones I’ll buy). Leave the skin on.  Once you have the fish sorted, it’s easy as 1-2-3! Combine coarse kosher salt and granulated sugar. I use a 1.5 : 1 ratio salt to sugar. I like Diamond Crystal salt, myself - the grains are perfectly coarse for curing. Add a pile of fresh chopped dill. A good dose of disco pepper. (You can also use any other herbs or spices, citrus zest…sky is the limit here…have fun with it.) Mix it well, and bury the fish in that mixture, with about 1/4 the cure under the skin and the rest on top. Wrap it with cheesecloth or plastic, and press it under light weight for 36-48 hours (or less according to some people…this here went 48 and could have been pulled at 36, but it was still buttery and lovely). Once it’s ready, remove it from the cure, rinse it well to arrest the curing process, pat it dry, and slice it paper thin, on a bias. I only slice as much off the main piece as I’m planning to eat at that time. Tightly wrap the rest and refrigerate for 5-7 days. From here you can do anything you want with it! Bagels, deviled eggs, sushi (yes…SUSHI), a bagel. A Benedict. Anything! Have fun with it.
